title: Tensor endpoint normalization of the binary support compositor
statement: For a finite operation stage S [def-sf-operation-stages] and a supplied Cartesian proper/open triangle j:X→V, b:V→W, q:V→Y, p:W→B, i:Y→B, s:B→Z with b p=q i, j,b,i open, b,i quasi-compact and q,p,s proper, take the three factor compactifications. For bounded constructible K and finite-Tor L, the forward support compositor tensored with L, followed by iterationSourceComparison and the tensor of raw alpha, equals sourceComparison. At the target, the forward support compositor followed by the tensor of torPullComposition intertwines binaryIterationTargetComparison with binaryTargetComparison. The comparison maps are explicit composites of coefficient units, support and pullback comparisons, using [lem-sf-finite-projection-iteration-realization]. The statement contains no projection morphism.

source.place: Composition sentence: realization of the same specified projection maps and support compositors.

proof.text: Use the proved fixedSupportComparison_composition_app from origin support normalization. Compare the two generic four-factor constructors by congruence in their final isomorphism argument, using symmetry of the canonical candidate comparison. The Cartesian compositor theorem then identifies this map with raw alpha on the supplied triangle. Cancel coefficient units to obtain forward support normalization.

Apply the proved binary_composition_source, the existing source endpoint now checked in the endpoint helper module. It tensors forward support normalization with the fixed presentation of L and uses the explicit source comparisons.

Apply fixedPullRealization_composition and tensor in the second slot. Cancel the coefficient unit by naturality; the inverse pullback compositor in trianglePull cancels, leaving binaryPullCast. Prove this cancellation at the level of natural isomorphisms before evaluating it at the input. Paste this tensor equation with naturality of the two support realizations and naturality of alpha to obtain the target endpoint equality. The morphism-indexed construction of binaryPullCast is proved equal to the original pCongr transport, so the specified map is preserved. Package the inverse-unit and tensor factors by unitTensorRealization before specializing the coefficient equivalence. Identify the underlying restricted pullback compositor before applying the realized tensor map, so no large derived object conversion is needed in this application.

proof_origin.place: Explicit forward support normalization and tensor endpoint pasting; unary pullback cancellation isolated.
